  "title": "gateway"

Package gateway is the HTTP entry point to a reva deployment: one address that accepts every request and forwards it to the service that declared the route it matches.

It keeps no route list of its own. Every HTTP service advertises the routes it declared in the service registry, and the gateway mirrors them into a router of the same kind the services themselves use, so a request is matched here exactly as it would be at the service. Adding an endpoint to a service, or a whole service to the deployment, needs no change here and none in whatever sits in front.
